members.name: value
members.doc: The value reported when this swatch is chosen.

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color: a hex code, `oklch(...)`, or a token such as `var(--tone-teal)`.

members.name: label
members.doc: Spoken name and tooltip, for example "Forest green". Falls back to the value.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Shown struck through and skipped by the keyboard, for a color that is unavailable.

types.name: ColorSwatchesProps
types.doc: A radio group of color swatches. One ring marks the choice and glides from swatch to swatch on a spring, and each swatch dips under the finger. Arrow keys move the choice, as in any radio group.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Runs when a swatch is chosen.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the group, for example "Color".

members.name: name
members.doc: Field name: adds a hidden input so the value submits with a form.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class names for the root element.
